title: Claude Code Plugin Permissions
description: Schema for defining Bash permissions required by Claude Code plugin skills

formerPatterns.description: Patterns this plugin shipped in earlier versions and no longer lists. The lt CLI removes each one once from the user's settings, so a narrowed or dropped rule leaves existing installs too; a rule the user adds again by hand afterwards stays. Never list a pattern another plugin still ships, and never internal host names or addresses: this file is public.

pattern.description: The permission pattern for Claude Code (e.g., 'Bash(npm test:*)')

description.description: Human-readable description of what this permission allows

usedBy.description: Array of skill names that require this permission
